label: Fibonacci square quarter arc construction
adaptation_note: Exact integer-ratio tiling overview without arcs plus six separately enlarged arc details. Original arc ordering/orientation retained; cross-frame scales explicitly differ.
acceptance_requirement: Keep the square sequence and arc endpoints; label the detail scale and do not claim the overview alone preserves the smallest arc regions.

frames.title: Six-square proportional tiling overview
frames.teaching_key: Six squares have sides 1, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 8 units, filling a 13 by 8 rectangle. This overview retains those exact integer side ratios but omits the quarter-arcs. The following six enlarged single-square details supply each arc in order. Detail squares are displayed at equal size regardless of original side length; do not compare their on-screen lengths as one scale. The two first quarter-arcs form a semicircle in the original arrangement. This is not an exact logarithmic/golden spiral.

frames.title: Quarter-arc 1, original square side 1
frames.teaching_key: Enlarged detail 1: the original square side is 1 units. Its two arc endpoints and quarter-circle orientation are retained. All details here use a 28-pin side for legibility, so this is not the overview scale. The external order key joins the six arcs; the original remains the complete common-scale construction.
